subject: Alzheimer's Disease Erodes the Brain's Master Metabolic and Circadian Nuclei
script: From Agewell Brief: Alzheimer's Disease Erodes the Brain's Master Metabolic and Circadian Nuclei. Long before memory fades, the hypothalamus undergoes physical shrinkage and transcriptional decay, disrupting the body's central pacemakers. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
